a.text: Being upfront before round 1: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if no storm hits after rounds 1 and 2, which is about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve already holds 4 cells, enough for one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If you'd rather settle this another way, say so, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round, so I'm breaking our agreement and I'm saying so plainly. If no storm comes, the reserve will be near 0. I can't run the generator alone, and you'd need my operate to rebuild. If we keep going, I'll operate with you each round so you can reach 4. I won't take any more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
